note: Fixed kiosk strings that live in the web app rather than in packages/rules/data. If wording drifts the app falls back to browser speech synthesis.
strings: Your answers have been saved for the study team to review.
If anything changes before your next visit, you can do another check-in or contact the study team.
If you feel you need urgent help at any time, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
Please ask the study team member nearby. They are happy to help you with this screen.
While you answer, the camera can read your pulse and breathing rate.
